narrative.overview: The site reads like a well-set personal book: a narrow page, generous margins, and almost no furniture. Hierarchy comes from proximity, scale, and weight alone — no card wall, no row numbering, no horizontal rule between entries, no trailing arrow on a post. The palette is warm off-white and charcoal in light, deep charcoal and warm gray in dark, with one restrained blue accent reserved for focus and link emphasis. Typography is Maple Mono, self-hosted: Fontsource Latin faces plus pre-split Maple Mono CN ranges, so both scripts share one rounded mono voice at a 2:1 rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: A centered 45rem reading column with a single vertical rhythm.
Separation by whitespace; rules survive only where they carry meaning.
Metadata lives under titles at every width, quiet and tabular.
Flat surfaces: no shadows, gradients, or elevated cards.

rules.name: The No-Rule Rule
rules.body: Horizontal rules never separate list entries, article header sections, TOC, or post navigation. Keep them only for semantic content, tables, and code chrome.

rules.name: The Metadata-Below Rule
rules.body: Date, reading time, and language mark always sit beneath the title as one quiet line, at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Section headings are written in natural case; no uppercase eyebrow or kicker introduces a section.

dos: Do keep the 45rem column and let whitespace do the separating.
Do place metadata under titles, in quiet ink, with tabular numerals.
Do keep every interactive element at least 44px tall.
Do express hover and focus with a 1px underline in rule-strong and a visible 2px focus ring.
Do check both themes and both scripts when changing type or spacing.
donts: Don't add horizontal rules between posts, projects, header, TOC, or post navigation.
Don't add row numbers, trailing arrows on posts, or uppercase section kickers.
Don't introduce cards, shadows, gradients, or bordered list rows.
Don't set metadata above the title or shrink it below 13px.
Don't swap in another typeface or a font CDN; self-hosted Maple Mono is the site's only voice.
